fpl_core_insights.resolution_policy: moving main candidate refreshed on reliability branch for governed audit; CI must validate before merge

decision_policy.pre_gw1_selection: exact GW1 expected points first; future legal transfer option value only among squads inside the disclosed near-equivalent GW1 point band
decision_policy.in_season_selection: receding-horizon maximum-EV policy from the actual current squad, bank, selling prices and free-transfer state; publish only the freshly solved first action
decision_policy.static_exact_horizon_role: internal diagnostic only; never user-facing authority
decision_policy.minutes_model: first-class EV input; uncertainty is not a separate safety penalty
decision_policy.uncertainty: correlated scenarios/CVaR/regret are diagnostics, not a second hidden forecast
decision_policy.deadline_mechanics: exact XI/captain/vice/autosub mechanics on the final selected squad
decision_policy.same_surface_check: sealed decision bundle identity and material input hashes must match
decision_policy.primary_selection: GW1 exact expected points first; future transfer option value only among launch squads inside the disclosed near-equivalent GW1 point band
decision_policy.future_transfer_rules: rolled free transfers, current cash/selling prices and explicit -4 hit costs; future moves remain contingent and are re-solved before every deadline
decision_policy.future_price_assumption: current official prices held fixed; no speculative price-rise forecast

recommendation.selector_reason: Exact GW1 expected points are the primary launch objective. Apex permits only the existing near-equivalent GW1 point tolerance, then uses the legal future transfer path to choose the most useful bank/FT structure.

epsilon_convergence.rule: >=13/15 overlap with max-EV and same captain at 0.25%, 0.50%, 1.00%

warnings: exact-mechanics shortlist hit its configured candidate limit before exhausting the disclosed near-optimal band
published captain is chosen in only 47% of uncertainty re-solves where he remains in the XI; the provisional diagnostic reference is 50%
covariance coefficients are transparent priors until enough 2026/27 deadline outcomes exist

shortlist.generator: flat-bench MILP with distinct-squad no-good cuts

equivalence.interpretation: Near-equivalent means within the disclosed exact-horizon point band; it is not a claim that a unique global optimum was proven.

joint_initial_path.note: GW1 exact expected points are the primary launch objective. The existing near-equivalent point band is a hard floor; only then may the legal future transfer path choose between launch-equivalent squads. Candidate convergence was checked between rank prefixes 32 and 48; rank 64 is solved only after another identity change. Solver-limit candidates are pruned only by certified objective bounds against an in-band incumbent, otherwise the selector fails closed. Execute only the current decision and rebuild projections before every later deadline.
